governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust. No row here is an active capability; each must pass the seeder's gap/lift screen, then human/eval gates, before any promotion. Source URLs are as reported by WebSearch/WebFetch; licenses marked 'unknown' were not confirmed on the repo page and carry a verify_note. SEC EDGAR, Federal Register, eCFR, CourtListener, US Code, FRED/market data, and PubMed/clinical are intentionally EXCLUDED (covered by other slices). serves_truth=false for everything downstream.
